trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied List size/index is small enough for the signed 32-bit trie math in setListBounds(); at the pinned commit nothing decides this, and the values are ToInt32-coerced and fed to the level-raising loops.

landing_point.why: Summary names the List 32-bit trie overflow; setListBounds holds both level-raising loops that use `1 << level`, and every size-changing List method calls it.

fix_sites.entry_point: List#set with a negative index / List#unshift (origin-raising loop); fix.diff:117-120
List#set with a large index / List#setSize / List#push (capacity-raising loop); fix.diff:128-129
helper constants MAX_LIST_SIZE and levelCapacity() added after getTailOffset; fix.diff:138-149

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changes are in one function in src/List.js:552-696. No second List implementation exists in the pinned tree (Stack, Range and Seq do not use a trie).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Weak. A solver could argue that setSize truncation (ToInt32 wrap at src/List.js:558-560) is documented behaviour rather than a hang, but the fix's single choke point covers it anyway.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Sparse in-range growth must keep working: setSize(2**30) is accepted with no allocation, and set(-(2**29)) must terminate and shift existing values to the end. An over-tight cap (e.g. 2**25) or rejecting negative origins would break these. fix.diff:48-64 tests both.

O6_input_shapes: numeric-string index through setIn key path ('1073741824', converted by wrapIndex at src/TrieUtils.ts:54-59)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: listNodeFor uses `rawIndex < 1 << (list._level + SHIFT)`, the same 32-bit shift that wraps once level reaches 30
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The published fix replaced the shift only in the two setListBounds loops. A maintainer could easily leave the read-side helper with the identical idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: VNode.removeBefore masks with `(1 << (level + SHIFT)) - 1`; removeAfter compares to `1 << (level + SHIFT)` at src/List.js:328
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same shift idiom in the trim path; reached by slice/shift on deep tries, so a how-type sibling that needs the overflow understood.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: GC loop `offsetShift += (1 << newLevel) * beginIndex` in setListBounds trim branch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Third 1<<level site in the same function that the fix left as-is; a planted copy-paste of the old loop body is plausible.

O9_family: integer overflow in size/index arithmetic leading to an infinite loop / unbounded allocation (CWE-190/835/400)

O10_build.project_tests: __tests__/List.ts (existing List tests incl. 'Does not infinite loop when sliced with NaN'), __tests__/ListJS.js

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a size cap inside updateList/List#set only (or only replace `1 << newLevel` in one loop), missing setSize/push/unshift and the ToInt32 wrap at src/List.js:556-560.

out_of_scope_notes: Map trie uses `1 << hash fragment` (src/Map.js:261) but that is bounded by MASK, not by caller sizes; not pursued.
unverified: Whether listNodeFor/removeBefore/removeAfter (src/List.js:292, 328, 541) actually misbehave at level 30 within the new 2**30 cap was not checked by execution; noted only as injection room.
